title: Module 5: Adult Learning Theory (Andragogy)
description: Contrasting Pedagogy (teaching children) with Andragogy (teaching adults), focusing on self-direction, prior experience, and problem-centered learning.

learning_objectives.statement: Differentiate pedagogy from andragogy in course architecture
Use Knowles' assumptions to audit adult-learning experiences
Design more problem-centered and self-directed learning pathways

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
